control.privilege: Ordinary app identity; installed permission registry listed public setter surface. Both commercial TVs independently admitted the fixed operation and returned the requested value. No root helper or policy change.
guards: Known G2/C2 model, firmware 23.25.55 and SDK 9.2.2 checked for each commit
Unique active/visible global non-account non-volatile descriptor with exactly three known active/visible enum choices
Owned foreground card and no overlay before validation and before commit
Expected old value checked twice, bounded validation time, queue age limit and one pending UI operation
One fixed setter; acknowledgement and independent value readback tracked separately; failure disables native editor for the session

interface: Shared PlxNative FormTable and Choice rows, separate current-value checkmark and foreground focus
Arrows and pointer focus do not emit a write; OK commits; Back/Cancel returns to the parent row
Busy control refuses repeated activation/navigation while its bounded worker completes
Stale/changed metadata withdraws the picker; previous-page hits cannot become another setting action
Post-commit confirmed value cannot be rewound by a background read cycle started before the commit
Native calls run on a separate worker; no optimistic value/checkmark update

earlier_ui_trial.scope: G2 change and restoration were independently observed, but the host expected a final receipt after one Back from General. It therefore stopped the test before the normal exit receipt. Pointer/core restoration and own package/path removal were checked privately. The corrected diagnostic returns to Home before its final Back. This earlier trial is not counted as full UI proof.
